cv_sections.summary:
I believe that the future will be all digital where applications and
websites would become an intrinsic part of humankind, this will
enable in saving time, getting things done at comfort of your home
and providing services to the remotest part of this world. As a
software engineer, I am committed to ensuring that I just don’t deliver
the website with a beautiful frontend but also a much more efficient
backend thereby enabling faster response time and a good user
experience.
From the standpoint of the employer, I would want to add more value
to the company that I am working for and just not be another person
getting things done that was allotted to him. As, from my previous
work experience there is a definitive history suggesting the same like
while I was working at Amazon, the project that I initiated resulted in
savings of more than 500k dollars in the gift card domain
Currently I am working in Qualcomm as a software engineer in their
DSP component of snapdragon processor. The work has enabled
me in learning how cpu are optimized in handling multiple different
tasks without overburdening the core part of the processor. Working
on developing add-ons and plugin ins in the next release of the
product. In my free time I like programming in Java and my hobbies
revolve around solving data structure and algorithm problem.
